description: Description: Elevate your Power BI reports with the Advanced Radial Gauge, a sleek and responsive speedometer-style visual designed to bring your Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to life. This visual provides a clear, at-a-glance view of performance against a target, presented in a modern and fully customizable interface. This gauge is perfect for business analysts, managers, and executives who need to monitor and understand performance metrics quickly. Whether you're tracking sales targets, operational efficiency, or financial goals, this visual provides an intuitive and immediate representation of your data. Tired of KPI cards that lack context? The Advanced Radial Gauge directly addresses this pain point with its powerful and unique custom tooltip feature. While a standard gauge shows only one value, our visual allows users to add multiple secondary measures to the tooltip. Now, when you hover over your main KPI (e.g., 85% of target achieved), you can instantly see related data—such as total revenue, units sold, or regional performance—that provides a complete story behind the number. This eliminates report clutter and provides deep insights without sacrificing a clean design. Key Features: * Advanced Custom Tooltips: Add multiple measures to the tooltip for rich, contextual information on hover. * Full Customization: Control fonts, colors, and sizes for the central text…
